project.name: Tourify Music Trust Ecosystem — Phase 1
project.notes: Repository-specific execution record. Phase 1 implementation is present behind six disabled flags. The worktree was dirty before Music Trust implementation; unrelated changes were preserved. Docker-backed Supabase validation, remote migration, feature activation, legal approval, and pilot enrollment remain release gates.

baseline_commands.name: Lint
baseline_commands.result: Exited 0 with repository-wide warnings and the Next.js next lint deprecation notice; no lint errors.

baseline_commands.name: Typecheck
baseline_commands.result: Passed at audit baseline and at the main Phase 1 integration checkpoint. A final post-build rerun emitted no diagnostics but did not exit and was stopped after several minutes.

baseline_commands.name: Unit tests
baseline_commands.command: npm test -- --runInBand lib/music/__tests__/music-access.test.ts lib/music/__tests__/upload-helpers.test.ts app/api/music/library/__tests__/route.test.ts; npm run test:unit -- --run __tests__/feed/music-post-preview.test.ts
baseline_commands.result: Jest music suites: 4 suites/26 tests passed after implementation. Vitest feed preview: 7 passed/1 pre-existing brittle source-text assertion failed.

baseline_commands.name: Build
baseline_commands.result: Production build remained silent in optimized compilation for several minutes and produced no artifact or error; the hung local process was stopped and no pass is claimed.

baseline_commands.name: Migration status
baseline_commands.result: Local Docker socket access was denied; escalation was rejected by the approval system usage limit. No remote database was contacted.

baseline_commands.name: Supabase advisors
baseline_commands.result: Not run: local Docker-backed database is unavailable and remote database access is outside the release boundary.

findings.summary: Canonical upload, private storage, access, Jukebox, marketplace, preview-worker, feature-flag, RBAC, report, and mobile paths are present and reusable.
Existing organizer admin access is too broad for private certification review; a narrower capability is required.
Static execution-plan schema validation passed with Ajv; TypeScript, lint, and 26 focused music tests pass.

blockers.reason: Legal/operations policy approval and remote deployment are outside this implementation.
blockers.safe_state: All six feature flags default disabled.

blockers.impact: Local migration application, generated local schema output, SQL RLS execution, and advisors could not be verified in this environment.
blockers.reason: Docker socket access was denied and escalation was unavailable due to the approval system usage limit.
blockers.safe_state: Migrations remain local and unapplied; no remote mutation or database reset was performed.

risks.description: Public upload changes break existing preview, commerce, or playback behavior.
risks.mitigation: Additive schema, feature flags, regression tests, and existing Jukebox/access reuse.

risks.description: False AI classification harms human artists.
risks.mitigation: Declarations plus private risk signals, human review, appeal, and no public detector accusation.

risks.description: Evidence or unreleased audio is exposed.
risks.mitigation: Private storage, narrow signed URLs, RLS, capability checks, and access logging.

risks.description: Certification language implies legal ownership or guaranteed AI absence.
risks.mitigation: Versioned narrow claims, legal review, disclaimers, suspension and revocation.

risks.description: Legacy catalog is mislabeled or automatically certified.
risks.mitigation: Explicit migration workflow and default non-certified status.
